name: Fujisawa Yukari
source:
Cursed with a small build and cute face, the high school senior has often been mistaken for a girl throughout his life. However, this supposed weakness is about to become his ticket into paradise. Looking for something to do in his spare time, Yukari applies for a job at Platinum, an exclusive Italian eatery. Even though the opening is really for women, his irresistable cuteness lands him the post. He hasn't been able to land himself a girlfriend yet, but hopefully that will change at Platinum!

[From [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/580736-do-you-like-horny-bunnies/faqs/33784]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url]]
